newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Eight injured in Indonesian mosque explosion.
newsitem.headline: Eight injured in Indonesian mosque explosion.

text.p: Eight children have been injured in an explosion in a mosque adjacent to a police station in a West Java town, police said on Monday.

A policeman at the Cibalong station, 30 km (18 miles) from the town of Tasikmalaya, told Reuters by telephone that one child was seriously hurt and seven suffered light injuries in the incident on Sunday night.
"We do not yet know the cause of the explosion," said the policeman, who declined to identify himself. He did not give further details.

The Kompas newspaper reported the explosion was suspected to have been caused by a grenade found in a rubbish bin outside the Cibalong police station, which was one of 12 police stations attacked by Moslem rioters on Thursday during riots which started in Tasikmalaya.

It said the children were playing with the grenade after evening prayers when it exploded. The newspaper said all eight children were taken to hospital in Tasikmalaya, 200 km (125 miles) southeast of Jakarta.
Thursday's riot in Tasikmalaya started after rumours that a Moslem teacher beaten by police last week had died.
Properties owned by ethnic Chinese as well as churches were the main targets of the rioters.
The violence extended beyond Tasikmalaya's town centre.
